title: 京王杯ジュニアSの後に・いざ春へ

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The crowd has finally been acquainted with my speed. Which means that from next year…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I have to give them a once-in-a-lifetime supreme showdown! I'm finally going to be participating in the Classics!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: All right! How should I charge into the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: How about I just go for it immediately?! Charging straight into a decisive battle is very Bakushin-like!
choice_data_list: That might be a bit too much Bakushin!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It would certainly be a bit too sudden of a challenge. So going by the book, it'd be better to…
choice_data_list: How about you try your hand at the Spring Stakes first?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ooh! That's a race where many outstanding Umamusume with their eyes set on the Satsuki Sho will also compete in, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Spring Stakes is 1,800 meters. It's longer than what she usually runs, but it would give her some time to think and consider various things before the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's a race befitting a model student!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I understand! I'll join the Spring Stakes next!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: With my speed, I'll be able to blast through the 1,800 meters in an instant!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It's decided then! Time to start training for medium-distance races!
